[#hash-backends-of-argon2]
.Who implements `kdfs::argon2i`, `kdfs::argon2id` (RFC 9106)
[cols="2,1,2,2,3,1",options="header"]
|===
| Function | Backend | The program's Jamfile names | Targets | Hmacs | Constant time

| `kdfs::argon2i`
| `sodium` (partial: fewer than 3 passes, more than one lane, a secret, associated data, a salt other than 16 bytes or a tag under 16 bytes: libsodium's crypto_pwhash_argon2i takes none of them)
| `/third_party//sodium`
| native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten
| -
| not stated

| `kdfs::argon2id`
| `sodium` (partial: more than one lane, a secret, associated data, a salt other than 16 bytes or a tag under 16 bytes: libsodium's crypto_pwhash_argon2id takes none of them)
| `/third_party//sodium`
| native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten
| -
| not stated
|===

What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `sodium`: libsodium 1.0.22: its headers state constant time for comparisons (sodium/utils.h) alone, not for its hashing, MAC, key derivation and password hashing functions (crypto_hash_*, crypto_xof_*, crypto_generichash_*, crypto_shorthash_*, crypto_auth_*, crypto_kdf_*, crypto_pwhash_*).

The default of `kdfs::argon2i` and `kdfs::argon2id`: `sodium` on every target, whatever the program links (<<hash-default-backend>>).
